description: Repair the reported Unicode line-separator defect in boltons/strutils.py. iter_splitlines and indent should recognize Unicode line/paragraph separators without splitting ordinary date/number text, and preserve existing empty-line, CRLF and custom-newline behavior. Only modify boltons/strutils.py. Inspect the implementation, run the provided public tests before and after editing, then briefly describe the fix. Do not modify tests or create extra files. Use python -B for commands so bytecode files are not created. This is a frozen repository module slice, not a full checkout. Public check: python -B test_public.py. Network and package installation are unavailable.
